ArrConfig.description: Connection to a named Radarr or Sonarr instance for guarded torrent removal.

host.description: HTTP(S) base URL, optionally including a reverse-proxy base path. Credentials, query strings, and fragments are forbidden. Trailing slashes are stripped.
host.title: Host

api_key.description: Nonempty Radarr/Sonarr API key from Settings > General. Treat as a secret.
api_key.title: Api Key

ArrConfig.title: ArrConfig

CleanupEmptyDirsConfig.description:
Prune old empty directories left by qBittorrent or other tools; runs last.

Only immediate children of configured roots are scanned. Never removes roots,
symlinks, nonempty directories, or paths referenced by any current torrent,
regardless of category/state. No cleanup if the torrent listing fails or paths
are missing/relative. Uses rmdir only, never recursive deletion. Requires local
storage mounts and write permission; a remote qBittorrent host alone is insufficient.

enabled.description: Enable local empty-directory cleanup. Disabled by default.
enabled.title: Enabled

directories.description: Cleanup roots; at least one is required when enabled. A plain absolute path means the same path in qBittorrent and tarr. For different mounts use 'qBittorrent-path:tarr-local-path' (qBittorrent first); only the local side is scanned. Both sides must be absolute, non-root paths without '..'. Plain and mapped roots can be mixed; conflicting mappings for the same source fail startup. Most-specific source mappings protect torrent paths. Defaults to [].
directories.title: Directories

name_pattern.description: Glob matched against directory basenames, not paths. The default matches qui's name--<8-character hash prefix> directories. Use '*' for every immediate child. Must be nonempty, contain no slash/backslash, and not be '.' or '..'. Quote patterns in YAML so '*' is not parsed as an alias.
name_pattern.title: Name Pattern

min_age_minutes.description: Minimum directory age in minutes, measured from its modification time. Zero disables the age guard; emptiness and torrent-path protection still apply.
min_age_minutes.title: Min Age Minutes

CleanupEmptyDirsConfig.title: CleanupEmptyDirsConfig

LoggingConfig.description: Structured logs always go to stdout; optionally also write rotating files.

level.description: Python log level, case-insensitive: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL, or NOTSET (WARN and FATAL aliases are also accepted).
level.title: Level

format.description: Structured output format for both stdout and optional file logs.
format.title: Format

file.description: Optional log file path; omit or use null for stdout only. Files rotate at 10 MiB. The process needs permission to create and write the file.
file.title: File

file_count.description: Number of rotated backup log files to retain when file logging is enabled.
file_count.title: File Count

LoggingConfig.title: LoggingConfig

MaintainFreeSpaceConfig.description:
Delete eligible torrents with content until qBittorrent reports enough free space.

Every matched tracker must pass its required seed-time OR ratio policy; no match
means no removal. Highest effective delete_priority goes first (the minimum
across matched trackers), then most swarm seeders. Desired limits and category
overrides do not govern eligibility. Space is re-read after each removal so
hard links are not assumed to reclaim space. Dry runs estimate from sizes.
Arr verification failures skip a candidate and continue to other torrents.

enabled.description: Enable this removal job. Disabled by default; review settings with --dry-run.
enabled.title: Enabled

categories.description: Include only these exact categories; omit or use null to include all. An empty list includes none. Entries may be strings, YAML null for uncategorized torrents, or objects with name and arr_verify_removal. Verification is not inherited by other jobs. ignore_categories always wins.
categories.title: Categories

ignore_categories.description: Never consider torrents in these exact categories, even if also included in categories. YAML null represents uncategorized torrents. Defaults to [].
ignore_categories.title: Ignore Categories

free_space_threshold_gibi.description: Target free space in GiB (1 GiB = 1024^3 bytes), measured by qBittorrent. Required and non-null when enabled. Below this threshold, remove eligible torrents until the target is met or no eligible candidates remain.
free_space_threshold_gibi.title: Free Space Threshold Gibi

MaintainFreeSpaceConfig.title: MaintainFreeSpaceConfig

QBittorrentConfig.description: qBittorrent WebUI connection settings only; polling and jobs belong at the root.

host.description: qBittorrent WebUI base URL reachable from tarr. With the included Docker Compose setup, use http://qbittorrent:8080 rather than localhost.
host.title: Host

password.description: WebUI login password. Replace the placeholder and treat as a secret.
password.title: Password

QBittorrentConfig.title: QBittorrentConfig

RemovalCategoryConfig.description: A removal category with optional per-job Radarr/Sonarr queue verification.

name.description: Exact, case-sensitive qBittorrent category name. YAML null (or an empty string) means torrents without a category. ignore_categories always takes precedence.
name.title: Name

arr_verify_removal.description: Names from the top-level arrs mapping; defaults to []. Immediately before removal, every named instance's /api/v3/queue is checked, including all pages and unknown items. Any matching downloadId blocks removal regardless of status. Unreachable instances, authentication failures, or invalid responses also block removal. Unknown names fail startup. Checks apply only to this job/category and run during dry runs too. Use action: Stop in set_seed_limits so qBittorrent cannot automatically delete before verification.
arr_verify_removal.title: Arr Verify Removal

RemovalCategoryConfig.title: RemovalCategoryConfig

RemoveStoppedConfig.description:
Remove completed torrents that remain stopped (pausedUP or stoppedUP).

Requires reaching an active qBittorrent seed-time OR ratio limit AND passing
every matched tracker's required policy. No tracker match means no removal.
Inherited, manual, and set_seed_limits limits are respected. Both active limits
unlimited prevent removal. Runs after set_seed_limits, fetching updated limits.
Actively seeding torrents are left alone; resuming resets the stopped timer.

enabled.description: Enable this removal job. Disabled by default; review settings with --dry-run.
enabled.title: Enabled

categories.description: Include only these exact categories; omit or use null to include all. An empty list includes none. Entries may be strings, YAML null for uncategorized torrents, or objects with name and arr_verify_removal. Verification is not inherited by other jobs. ignore_categories always wins.
categories.title: Categories

ignore_categories.description: Never consider torrents in these exact categories, even if also included in categories. YAML null represents uncategorized torrents. Defaults to [].
ignore_categories.title: Ignore Categories

delay_minutes.description: Minutes continuously observed as completed and stopped before removal. Zero allows immediate removal once eligibility checks pass. Timers reset on restart or if the torrent resumes/is incomplete; positive delays need --daemon.
delay_minutes.title: Delay Minutes

on_delete.description: Remove keeps downloaded files; RemoveWithContent deletes them too.
on_delete.title: On Delete

RemoveStoppedConfig.title: RemoveStoppedConfig

RemoveUnregisteredConfig.description:
Delete torrents and content after a tracker continuously reports unregistered.

Tracker retention requirements do not apply to this job. Category exclusions
and any configured Arr verification still apply. Runs before all other jobs.

enabled.description: Enable this removal job. Disabled by default; review settings with --dry-run.
enabled.title: Enabled

categories.description: Include only these exact categories; omit or use null to include all. An empty list includes none. Entries may be strings, YAML null for uncategorized torrents, or objects with name and arr_verify_removal. Verification is not inherited by other jobs. ignore_categories always wins.
categories.title: Categories

ignore_categories.description: Never consider torrents in these exact categories, even if also included in categories. YAML null represents uncategorized torrents. Defaults to [].
ignore_categories.title: Ignore Categories

delay_minutes.description: Wait this many minutes after first observing unregistered status, which some trackers report transiently. Zero removes immediately. Timers are in memory and reset on restart; positive delays are useful only with --daemon.
delay_minutes.title: Delay Minutes

RemoveUnregisteredConfig.title: RemoveUnregisteredConfig

SeedLimits.description:
A complete seed policy; both seed_time_minutes and ratio are required.

Removal requires reaching the seed time OR ratio, not both. If both are -1,
this policy prevents removal. Limits are validated even for disabled jobs.

seed_time_minutes.description: Nonnegative integer seed time in minutes (10080 = 7 days, 20160 = 14 days). -1 means unlimited: this dimension never qualifies a torrent for removal. Unlimited is greater than any finite value when comparing policies.
seed_time_minutes.title: Seed Time Minutes

ratio.description: Finite, nonnegative uploaded/downloaded ratio. -1 means unlimited: this dimension never qualifies a torrent for removal. Unlimited is greater than any finite value when comparing policies.
ratio.title: Ratio

SeedLimits.title: SeedLimits

SetSeedLimitsCategoryConfig.description: Explicitly managed category with a required action and optional complete override.

name.description: Exact, case-sensitive category to manage. YAML null (or an empty string) means uncategorized torrents. Names must be unique in set_seed_limits.
name.title: Name

override.description: Replace both tracker-derived desired limits. Both fields are mandatory and each must be at least EVERY configured tracker's corresponding required limit, even for Stop actions or disabled jobs. -1 is unlimited. Startup checks these comparisons. Omit or use null to use tracker desired limits. Torrents with no matching tracker are still skipped.

action.description: Required qBittorrent action when a share limit is reached: Default uses the global action; Stop stops seeding; Remove removes the torrent but keeps files; RemoveWithContent also deletes files; EnableSuperSeeding enables super-seeding. There is no global tarr action or inheritance. Use Stop for Arr-verified categories and let remove_stopped perform guarded removal.
action.title: Action

SetSeedLimitsCategoryConfig.title: SetSeedLimitsCategoryConfig

SetSeedLimitsConfig.description:
Reconcile share limits only for explicitly listed categories with matching trackers.

Uses the maximum desired limit in each dimension across matching trackers;
unlimited dominates. A complete category override replaces both limits.
Unlisted categories and torrents without a matching tracker remain untouched.
Sets inactive-seeding time to unlimited and MatchAny semantics. Runs before
remove_stopped so guarded removal sees updated active limits.

enabled.description: Enable share-limit reconciliation. Disabled by default.
enabled.title: Enabled

categories.description: Opt-in list of exact categories. Each entry requires name and action; names must be unique (null and empty string both mean uncategorized). Defaults to []: no torrents are managed. No tracker match means no change, even with override.
categories.title: Categories

SetSeedLimitsConfig.title: SetSeedLimitsConfig

TrackerConfig.description:
Retention policy for a tracker. Every matching tracker applies to a torrent.

Each desired limit must be at least its corresponding required limit; equality
is allowed and -1 (unlimited) is greater than finite values. Startup enforces
these comparisons. Torrents without any matching tracker are left alone by
set_seed_limits, remove_stopped, and maintain_free_space.

name.description: Tracker display name used in logs.
name.title: Name

hosts.description: Announce hostnames, without URL schemes or paths. Matching is case-insensitive and includes subdomains. All matching configured trackers apply once each.
hosts.title: Hosts

required.description: Minimum retention policy for remove_stopped and maintain_free_space. Every matched tracker must pass its required seed-time OR ratio threshold. remove_unregistered bypasses this policy.

desired.description: Share limits applied by set_seed_limits. Each field must be at least the corresponding required field. Across matching trackers, the maximum in each dimension wins; unlimited dominates. A category override replaces both.

delete_priority.description: Free-space deletion priority; higher values are deleted first, then torrents with more swarm seeders. The effective priority is the MINIMUM across all matched trackers. Negative values are allowed. Priority never bypasses retention.
delete_priority.title: Delete Priority

TrackerConfig.title: TrackerConfig

description:
tarr configuration. Only qbittorrent and a nonempty trackers list are required.

All jobs are disabled by default. Start with --dry-run before enabling removal
or share-limit changes. Run once, or poll with --daemon. Job order is
remove_unregistered, set_seed_limits, remove_stopped, maintain_free_space,
cleanup_empty_dirs. Jobs and interval_seconds belong at the root, never under
qbittorrent. Unknown keys and invalid policies stop startup, even for disabled
jobs. The schema validates structure; startup also checks path safety, known
Arr references, category uniqueness, and comparisons between retention limits.

qbittorrent.description: Required qBittorrent WebUI connection; contains no job or polling settings.

interval_seconds.description: Seconds between reconciliation passes with --daemon. Ignored for a single pass. A failed daemon pass is logged before the next attempt.
interval_seconds.title: Interval Seconds

remove_unregistered.description: Delete unregistered torrents with content after a continuous delay. Bypasses tracker retention policies but respects category filters and Arr verification. Omit to leave disabled.

remove_stopped.description: Remove completed, stopped torrents after a delay when an active share limit and every matched tracker's required policy pass. Arr verification applies. Omit to leave disabled; runs after set_seed_limits.

maintain_free_space.description: Delete eligible torrents with content to reach a free-space target, ordered by effective tracker priority then swarm seeders. Tracker required policies and Arr verification apply. Omit to leave disabled.

set_seed_limits.description: Reconcile share limits for explicitly listed categories using matched tracker desired limits or complete overrides. Each category requires an action. Omit to leave disabled.

cleanup_empty_dirs.description: Prune old, empty immediate child directories on locally mounted storage, protecting symlinks and paths used by every current torrent. Runs last. Omit to leave disabled.

trackers.description: Required nonempty tracker policies. All matching announce hostnames (including subdomains) apply. Required limits guard removal; desired limits control share settings. No matching tracker means no action except remove_unregistered.
trackers.title: Trackers

logging.description: Structured stdout and optional rotating file logs; defaults to INFO/logfmt.

arrs.description: Optional named Radarr/Sonarr connections referenced by removal categories' arr_verify_removal lists. Names are case-sensitive; unknown references fail startup. Defaults to {}. Checks guard only tarr's deletions, not other tools or qBittorrent's autonomous removal.
arrs.title: Arrs
